top_signals.title: Clampdown on China Chip Loophole; Nvidia Earnings Countdown
top_signals.summary:
Selling pressure on US technology stocks eased ahead of Nvidia Corp.’s much-anticipated results that could prove as pivotal for the company as for the broader artificial-intelligence trade.

Nvidia’s earnings arrive at a time when the world’s most important chipmaker is facing what may be the greatest upheaval in its history. Following the ouster of Jensen Huang, the focus will extend beyond the usual quarterly numbers and outlook to whether the new leadership team can maintain its relationships across the AI value chain and keep product plans on track.

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)
